regime_context: The China A-shares detector shows a narrow eligible-set (only 4 of 22 themes pass the absolute-trend gate) with Banks as the lone high-durability leader shared by rotation. The backtest verdict is unusually harsh for this market: the one validated edge (the trend gate) did_NOT_hold_here, so the entire framework is display-only for A-shares. Given track_record dir_accuracy of 0.368 (worse than a coin flip on direction) and gate_helps=false, I am keeping conviction low and issuing few theses.
emerging_watch: Watching Innovative Pharma & CXO (rank 2, score 0.998, eligible=true) — it is the confirmed challenger with only a 0.017 score margin behind Banks. The observable condition that would retire this watch is a confirmed leadership handoff: cn_pharma_cxo overtakes cn_banks on score AND holds durability above 0.6 with breadth above 0.5 for 5 consecutive sessions, which would qualify as a CONFIRMED (not predicted) handoff.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only theme that is simultaneously high-ranking, trend-gate eligible, high-durability (0.73), and broad (0.889 breadth). The durability leg is the only coincident signal worth leaning on for staying power. However, the rank itself is a focus lens, not alpha, and the trend gate has no drawdown-reduction edge on this market's history — so this is a weak, de-risked continuation lean, not a return call.
evidence: breadth 0.889, far above any other theme
theses.dissent: Banks are crowded (z=1.78) and this market's gate mean-reverts; the broad high score could mark a late-stage consolidation that whipsaws. The one validated edge (drawdown avoidance via the gate) does not hold here, so there is no structural reason to expect the trend to persist.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics

The absolute-trend gate is the only leg with any historical downside edge, and this theme fails it. Avoid is the honest conditional lean while it remains ineligible.
evidence: breadth 0.059, nearly a one-name idiosyncratic move
